t: Большой театр представляет "Ромео и Джульетту" в честь Михаила Лавровского
d: В четверг, 29 октября, одна из ярчайших звезд советского балета Михаил Лавровский отмечает 85-летие. В его честь Большой театр показывает в этот вечер балет "Ромео и Джульетта" его отца, возобновленный юбиляром.
te: The Bolshoi Theatre Presents Romeo and Juliet in Honor of Mikhail Lavrovsky
de: On Thursday, October 29, one of the brightest stars of the Soviet ballet Mikhail Lavrovsky celebrates his 85th anniversary. In his honor, the Bolshoi Theatre shows on this evening the ballet "Romeo and Juliet" of his father, resumed by the anniversary.

t: В Кремле раскрыли подробности предстоящей встречи по Украине в Абу-Даби. Главное
d: Трехсторонние переговоры в Абу-Даби с участием России, США и Украины состоятся после 4 ноября, их точная дата будет определена в ближайшее время. Об этом заявил помощник президента России Юрий Ушаков.
te: The Kremlin has revealed the details of the upcoming meeting on Ukraine in Abu Dhabi. Mainstream.
de: The trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi with the participation of Russia, the United States and Ukraine will take place after November 4, their exact date will be determined in the near future. This was stated by Russian presidential aide Yuri Ushakov.

t: Три дня отпуска - девять дней отдыха: В Госдуме объяснили, когда выгодно отдыхать в 2027 году

te: Three days of vacation - nine days of rest: the State Duma explained when it is profitable to rest in 2027
de: In 2027, vacation time should be chosen based on the number of working days in a given month. For employees with a fixed salary and a five-day week, it is financially more profitable to go on vacation in March, April, July, August, September…

de: Two passenger planes that flew from Istanbul to Moscow turned in the sky and took the opposite course. The reason was the restrictions at Vnukovo airport, writes TASS, citing a source in air traffic control services.

d: Возможное досрочное завершение ИТ-ипотеки больше повлияет на сферу информационных технологий, чем на рынок недвижимости, считают эксперты. Количество продаваемых квартир по этой программе не так велико.
te: How will the possible completion of the IT mortgage affect the housing market? Opinion of the “WG” experts
de: The possible early completion of an IT mortgage will affect the IT sector more than the real estate market, experts say. The number of apartments sold under this program is not so large.

d: Россияне, получающие пенсию с 1-го по 10-е число месяца, в декабре получат сразу две выплаты - декабрьскую и январскую. Об этом пишет ТАСС, ссылаясь на главу комитета Госдумы по труду, соцполитике и делам ветеранов Элеонору Кавшар.
te: In the state Duma told which of the pensioners will receive two payments in December
de: Russians who receive a pension from the 1st to the 10th of the month, in December will receive two payments at once - December and January. This writes TASS, referring to the head of the Duma Committee on labor, social policy and veterans Affairs Eleanor Kavshar.

te: Two residents of Kamchatka were convicted for fictitious registration of migrants
de: Petropavlovsk-Kamchatka City Court has convicted a 57-year-old man and a 27-year-old woman. They were found guilty of organizing the illegal stay of foreign citizens in Russia using forged documents.

de: The Ukrainian military in the Georgian DPR tried to trap Russian fighters. But they did not succeed, told TASS commander of the assault battalion of the 239th tank regiment of the group of troops "Center" Viktor Markov.

te: In Magadan in a fire in a private house killed two women
de: In Magadan, two women died in a fire in the 3rd Transport Lane in a private house. One of them had previously been rescued from a burning nearby building and was undergoing treatment.

de: In Transbaikalia, the prosecutor’s office found violations of sanitary and epidemiological requirements at the Kultuminsky mining and processing plant. They could have triggered an outbreak of acute intestinal infection that affected 57 people.

d: В ночь на 29 октября осень на территории Красноярска и окрестностей со скоростью снега сменилась зимой - в столице края и в его центральных районах выпали сезонные осадки.
te: Heavy snowfall covered Krasnoyarsk and opened to tourists national park "Pillars"
de: On the night of October 29, autumn in the territory of Krasnoyarsk and the surrounding area with the speed of snow changed in winter - seasonal precipitation fell in the capital of the region and in its central regions.
